packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major Go module updates. Majors deliberately fall outside the group and ride one PR each (Renovate's default), so a breaking bump is never buried in a routine batch.

github.com/oapi-codegen/runtime stays Renovate-managed in the ordinary group, and the GENERATOR is deliberately NOT: the codegen pin (v2.8.0) lives in the Makefile's OAPI_VERSION variable and in the two `go install ...@v2.8.0` run lines in ci.yaml and release.yaml -- surfaces no enabled manager reads -- and that is correct, because bumping the generator without running `make generate` and committing the regenerated client turns `make check-generated` red on a diff nobody made. Generator bumps are a manual three-site edit plus `make generate` in one commit. The runtime LIBRARY is safe for Renovate: `make check-generated` regenerates with the PINNED generator, so a runtime bump cannot fake contract drift, and the PR's CI compiles and tests the committed client against the new runtime.

One PR for all GitHub Actions pin updates (the manager also emits uses-with tool deps, so no extra datasource rule is needed). groupSingleUpdates keeps the group's branch/title even when only one update is due (drift PR #41: a single-update group otherwise wears the solo title).

Go toolchain bumps stay a manual ATOMIC edit across go.mod + ci.yaml + release.yaml. Renovate sees the toolchain at two decoupled sites riding two different groups -- the go.mod `go` directive (gomod manager: depName `go`, datasource golang-version) and the setup-go `go-version:` inputs in ci.yaml/release.yaml (github-actions manager: depType uses-with, depName `go`, packageName actions/go-versions, datasource github-releases) -- so two separate PRs could desync them, and no test enforces lockstep. This one matchDepNames rule disables BOTH extractions; setup-python's python-version stays managed (docs-only workflow, harmless). Better future fix: point ci.yaml/release.yaml at `go-version-file: go.mod` as docs.yaml already does, after which this rule can narrow to the gomod site only.
